question: Eight friends (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H) sit around a circular table, all of them facing the centre. Only three people sit between G and D. D sits second to the right of F. C is a neighbour of D. A sits third to the left of B and neighbour of H. H sits second to the right of C. E and A are not immediate neighbours of each other. Who is sitting between B and E, when counted from the left of E?
